subject: Mutual Action Plan + Performance Acceptance: costed throughput & MAP attachments
messages:
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Hart <sophie.hart@ledgerwave.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-20T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Draft MAP + performance acceptance criteria (first pass)

Hi Sophie,

Thanks for a constructive sync earlier. Per our conversation, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that combines the evaluation checkpoints and the performance acceptance criteria LedgerWave requested. High-level items:

- Week 0 (kickoff): test dataset ingestion, access & IAM, baseline prompts.
- Week 1: baseline latency + TTFT runs (single-slot) for model variants.
- Week 2: sustained throughput & concurrency sweep (up to target sustained QPS).
- Week 3: production-like replay and stability (72-hour sustained window).
- Acceptance gate: p95 TTFT <= 250ms, p95 token latency <= 55ms, sustained throughput meeting target workload with <=5% error rate.

We've included a costed throughput worksheet in the MAP (tab: Unit-Econ) — it shows per-1M-token unit costs under three serving configs: Hosted (standard), Dedicated (reserved), and Dedicated+Batch (aggressive batching + KV caching).

Attachments: LW_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP + test plan + unit econ).

Next steps: if the MAP looks good I'll schedule the kickoff for Wednesday and Marcus will share the initial benchmark harness and target scripts.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

(attachment: LW_MAP_v2.xlsx)

From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Hart <sophie.hart@ledgerwave.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-21T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Draft MAP + performance acceptance criteria (first pass)

Sophie --

Following up with the perf team’s first-run results from yesterday's baseline and throughput sweep. I attached the CSV export (redwood_throughput_results_20260921.csv) and pasted a short summary below. We ran the "finance-chat" prompt set LedgerWave provided (avg output length 320 tokens). Test harness: 8xA100-equivalent nodes in Dedicated pool, model: customer-selected 13B quantized variant.

Summary (representative):
- Baseline single-request: TTFT median = 95ms, TTFT p95 = 240ms.
- Per-token latency (median) = 28ms/token; p95 token latency = 50ms/token.
- Sustained throughput (steady-state over 30min window) = 22 requests/sec (RPS) at concurrency=48.
- Average tokens/sec (system-wide) = 22 RPS * 320 tokens = ~7,040 tokens/sec sustained.
- Peak burst observed during concurrency ramp to 80 = 38 RPS (short spikes), average error-rate during spike = 3.8%.

Unit economics (observed during run):
- Measured GPU-hour consumption (normalized): 0.85 GPU-hours per 1M tokens served under Dedicated config with batching enabled.
- Rough cost proxy (infra + instance amortized): $0.88 per 1M tokens for Dedicated; with extra batching/KV caching can be driven to ~$0.32 per 1M tokens in Dedicated+Batch scenario. Hosted public endpoint (no reserve) estimated at ~$1.50 per 1M tokens.

Acceptance check against MAP gates: p95 TTFT target (<=250ms) -- PASS (240ms observed). Sustained throughput target in the MAP for LedgerWave was 20 RPS with 300-ish token avg — measured sustained 22 RPS at 320 tokens (meets target, cost slightly higher due to longer outputs).

Attached: redwood_throughput_results_20260921.csv (raw run), quick notes in MAP_acceptance_summary.pdf. Happy to walk through the raw plots on a quick screen-share.

- Marcus
Perf Lead, Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood_throughput_results_20260921.csv)

From: Sophie Hart <sophie.hart@ledgerwave.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, eng@ledgerwave.com
Date: 2026-09-21T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + performance acceptance criteria (first pass)

Thanks Marcus, Vanessa — this is really helpful. A few quick clarifying Qs before we lock the MAP: 

1) Can you share the run configuration (batch sizes, kv-cache enabled yes/no, tokenization settings) so we can compare vs our internal baseline?
2) For the unit econ numbers: are those including storage / network egress costs or purely infra GPU amortized?
3) Our procurement needs the acceptance gate to include a 72-hour stability window at target load — can we schedule that for Week 3?

If those answers are ok, I can get legal/procurement to start the SOW review.

— Sophie
Head of Engineering, LedgerWave
(attachment: none)

From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Hart <sophie.hart@ledgerwave.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-21T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Draft MAP + performance acceptance criteria (first pass)

Sophie — quick answers inline: 

1) Run config: batch_size=16 (dynamic batching), KV-cache enabled: yes (session pinned); tokenization: byte-level BPE, truncation at 1024 tokens, generation max 512 tokens, sampling temp 0.0 for deterministic eval runs. Detailed harness config attached in the CSV metadata.

2) Unit econ: the numbers above are infra + instance amortization only (GPU cycles, host costs). They do NOT include network egress, customer data storage, or third-party license fees. We put a conservative +20% buffer in the MAP Unit-Econ tab for those items so procurement has a starting number.

3) 72-hour stability window: yes — we recommend a staged run (24h smoke, 48h sustained) during Week 3. We’ll run it in Dedicated with reserved capacity and historical load replay.

I’ll add these clarifications to the MAP and upload an updated MAP_acceptance_summary.pdf.

- Marcus

(attachment: MAP_acceptance_summary.pdf)
